method: Additional WIC Works and SNAP-Ed primary-source ingredient screen after the all-old market audit. Facts below are compact factual transcriptions, not an archived copy of the source. Source quantities and preparation states are preserved. SOURCE_MAPPED is not rights, market, quantity-normalization or final-corpus acceptance. No recipe photos, branding or source prose are licensed by this record.

tnc.result: The collection expressly permits downloading and copying its materials. This is not an express unrestricted commercial/derivative grant. Apply the approved direct-FNS project risk posture, retain attribution, and exclude photos/logos/trademarks. Eggs and Applesauce binaries and recipe-page visuals were reviewed; no copyright or permission notice was found in their full text.

harvest.result: Primary FNS-430 binary SHA-256 36582eae02afef1fbb3e9b5ae3e1a2409c73bb84a60e8c40d53e486fad56169e verified (4,367,674 bytes, 98 pages). Both pages of each of the six mapped cards, acknowledgments and back cover visually reviewed. No third-party copyright/licensing restriction on selected cards. Tribal and contractor acknowledgments are provenance, not an automatic exclusion or a license. Apply accepted direct-FNS project risk posture; no public-domain or unrestricted commercial/derivative assertion.

wic.result: WIC submission policy requires permission to share, with verification and applicable image licenses; it is not a commercial/derivative grant. Reviewed direct-FNS recipes use accepted project risk posture. Preserve local credits and exclude source images/logos/trademarks. Edamame external original carries copyright but FAQ question6 independently permits recipe-only reuse with linkback (not recipe and photo together); explicit original link is required. No public-domain or unlimited commercial/derivative assertion.

snap.result: Reviewed directly FNS-hosted recipe text carries no third-party copyright/licensing restriction. Apply the accepted direct-FNS project risk posture, preserving any recoverable original-author credits and exact source. A missing separate commercial grant is not a renewed blocker. SNAP's photo-gallery terms apply to photos, not a blanket recipe license; no images/logos/trademarks are imported. MyPlate links often return a generic replacement landing page or inaccessible content; this is recorded as an attribution-retrieval limitation, not proof of either restriction or unrestricted rights.

step_facts: Wash produce; peel potatoes and slice 1/4 inch thick.
Toss potatoes with salt and 2 Tbsp oil; spread on parchment-covered baking sheet and cover with foil or another sheet.
Start in cold oven; set 450 F, bake 30 minutes; uncover 15 minutes, then flip and continue until both faces caramelize.
In medium pot heat 2 Tbsp oil; soften onion 2–3 minutes; add garlic, ginger, curry and greens.
Add quinoa and selected water; boil then cover and simmer about 15 minutes until absorbed. Fluff, season and add remaining 1 Tbsp oil.
Serve grain/greens topped with potatoes and lemon juice.
